title: November 2026
sub: Social media and bulk email. Everything we publish this month, in one place.

posts.title: Serving 10+ sectors
posts.ar:
نخدم أكثر من 10 قطاعات.. بخبرة تُلبّي احتياجات كل قطاع.
نقدم حلول تموين وإعاشة متكاملة، مصممة لتلبية متطلبات مختلف القطاعات بكفاءة واحترافية.
posts.en:
Serving 10+ Sectors with Expertise Tailored to Every Industry.
We provide integrated catering solutions tailored to the needs of diverse industries with efficiency and professionalism.

posts.title: Quality begins with ingredient selection
posts.ar:
الجودة تبدأ من اختيار المكونات لنضمن جودة عالية في أدق التفاصيل..
نحرص على جودة المكونات ودقة التحضير لنقدم وجبات تلبي معايير الجودة وسلامة الغذاء.
posts.en:
Quality Begins with Ingredient Selection, Ensuring high quality in every detail.
We prioritize ingredient quality and precise preparation to deliver meals that meet food quality and safety standards.

posts.title: Behind every success is a dedicated team
posts.ar:
وراء كل نجاح فريق متكامل، يقدم خدمات إعاشة بجودة واحترافية.
نعتمد على كفاءة فريقنا وتكامل جهوده لتقديم خدمات إعاشة موثوقة بمعايير عالية من الجودة.
posts.en:
Behind every success is a dedicated team delivering catering services with quality and professionalism.
Our team's expertise and collaboration drive reliable catering services with high standards of quality and professionalism.

posts.title: AI course graduation 🎓
posts.ar:
اختتمنا بنجاح دورة الذكاء الاصطناعي لفريق الميس 🎓✨
خطوة جديدة نحو تطوير مهارات فريقنا وتبنّي أحدث التقنيات لخدمة عملائنا بكفاءة أعلى.
شكراً لكل من شارك وساهم في إنجاح الدورة 👏
[سيتم إضافة الصور بعد الاحتفال]
posts.en:
We've successfully wrapped up our AI training course for the Al Mays team 🎓✨
Another step toward upskilling our people and embracing new technology to serve our clients better.
Thank you to everyone who took part 👏
[Photos will be added after the celebration]

posts.title: Reliable catering that supports your success
posts.ar:
إعاشة موثوقة تدعم نجاح أعمالكم..
نفخر بتقديم حلول إعاشة متكاملة تجمع بين جودة الخدمة وكفاءة التشغيل لتلبية احتياجات عمالتكم.
posts.en:
Reliable Catering That Supports Your Success.
We deliver integrated catering solutions that combine service quality and operational efficiency to meet your workforce's needs.

posts.title: We perfect every detail
posts.ar:
نتقن التفاصيل لنقدم جودة تُصنع بثقة، ومذاقًا يترك أثرًا.
في الميس للتموين والإعاشة، نلتزم بالجودة والاحترافية في كل مرحلة من مراحل إعداد الطعام.
posts.en:
We Perfect Every Detail to Deliver Quality You Can Trust and Flavors You Won't Forget.
At Al-Mays Catering, we are committed to quality and professionalism at every stage of food preparation.

posts.title: Cleanliness you can trust
posts.ar:
نظافة بمعايير معتمدة.. وثقة تُبنى على الالتزام.
في الميس للتموين والإعاشة، نلتزم بمعايير النظافة وسلامة الغذاء لضمان بيئة عمل صحية وآمنة، وجودة تستحق ثقتكم.
posts.en:
Cleanliness You Can Trust. Standards We Uphold.
At Al-Mays Catering, we uphold high standards of cleanliness and food safety to ensure a safe, hygienic environment and earn our clients' trust.

emails.title: Integrated catering for every sector
emails.ar:
حلول إعاشة متكاملة.. بجودة تلبي احتياجات جميع القطاعات.
من الفنادق والمستشفيات إلى المصانع ومواقع المقاولات والشركات والجهات الحكومية، تقدم الميس للتموين والإعاشة حلولًا غذائية متكاملة تشمل تجهيز الوجبات وتغليفها وتوصيلها، وفق أعلى معايير الجودة وسلامة الغذاء، وبأسعار تناسب احتياجات وميزانيات عملائنا.
emails.en: From hotels and hospitals to factories, construction sites, corporations, and government entities, Al-Mays provides integrated catering solutions, including meal preparation, packaging, and delivery, while maintaining high standards of quality and food safety at competitive prices tailored to your needs and budget.

emails.title: Fueling your workforce
emails.ar:
طاقة لعمالتك.. وجودة تستمر. 💚
تؤمن الميس بأن التغذية الجيدة أساس استمرارية الإنتاجية، لذلك نقدم حلول التموين والإعاشة للمصانع والمنشآت الصناعية، بوجبات متوازنة وخدمات تشغيلية موثوقة تلبي احتياجات عمالتك يوميًا.
emails.en:
Fueling Your Workforce. Sustaining Productivity. 💚
At Al-Mays, we believe that proper nutrition is essential to maintaining productivity. We provide reliable catering solutions for factories and industrial facilities, delivering balanced meals and professional food services tailored to your workforce's daily needs.

emails.title: Catering for project sites
emails.ar:
توفر الميس للتموين والإعاشة حلولًا متكاملة لقطاع المقاولات ومواقع الإنشاءات، من خلال وجبات غذائية متنوعة وخدمات إعاشة موثوقة، بجودة عالية وأسعار تناسب ميزانية مشاريعكم.
نعتني بتغذية عمالتك، لتواصل مشاريعكم مسيرتها بكفاءة واستمرارية 💚
emails.en:
Al-Mays provides comprehensive catering solutions for construction companies and project sites, delivering diverse meals and reliable food services with high quality and competitive prices tailored to your project budget.
We take care of your workforce's nutrition, so your projects can keep moving forward efficiently. 💚

emails.title: Elevating your employees' dining
emails.ar:
🥗 نرتقي بضيافة موظفيكم.. بجودة تستحقها فرقكم.
تقدم الميس للتموين والإعاشة حلولًا غذائية متكاملة للشركات والمؤسسات والمنشآت التشغيلية، من خلال وجبات متنوعة ومتوازنة تُحضّر بعناية، مع الالتزام بمعايير الجودة وسلامة الغذاء.
emails.en:
🥗 Elevating Your Employees' Dining Experience with Quality Your Team Deserves.
Al-Mays provides comprehensive catering solutions for companies, institutions, and operational facilities, offering diverse and balanced meals carefully prepared in accordance with quality and food safety standards.

mp.title: November marketing plan
mp.sub: Month 1 of 3 · build presence, fix the website, get found on Google, launch ChatGPT ads, capture every lead on WhatsApp.

pillars.name: Social media
pillars.aim: Show Al Mays as the reliable contract-catering partner, with real operations and people.
items: Content strategy & monthly calendar
New post design approved and applied to every post
3 feed posts a week on Instagram & LinkedIn
Stories 3–4 times a week: client sites, central kitchen operations, food safety, our team at work
1 LinkedIn company-activity post a week: contracts, training, certifications, events
Content review & editing before publishing
Photo & video shoot at client sites and the central kitchen
method: Monthly content calendar approved on the board
Design every post in the new template
Review & edit before publishing
Schedule posts and stories in advance
Check insights every Monday
tools: Connected to our design & publishing tools to draft captions, build designs and schedule posts

pillars.name: Website upgrade
pillars.aim: A website that looks like Al Mays today and turns visits into quote requests.
items: Upgrade plan & page-by-page checklist
Fix broken pages & links (0+ counters, phone & email links, branches, ar_SA)
Floating WhatsApp button & clear Request a quote form
Replace all photos with the new shoot
Keywords on every page
New company profile + Al Mays video on the home page
method: Audit every page and list issues
Fix broken pages, links and counters
Replace photos and refresh content
Add keywords, titles and descriptions
Launch and track visits & quote requests
spend: Form plugin (WhatsApp is in the WhatsApp budget)
Video hosting (ad-free, for the Al Mays video)
Gaps not covered by our shoot

pillars.name: Google Ads & SEO
pillars.aim: Show up — paid and organic — when companies search for catering in Saudi Arabia, and pay only for clicks that become quote requests.
items: Campaign 1 · Search (Arabic): contract catering by sector & city
Campaign 2 · Search (English): corporate & industrial catering in KSA
Campaign 3 · Remarketing: Display & YouTube with the corporate video to past visitors
Conversion tracking: quote form, calls, WhatsApp clicks
SEO: keywords on every page, titles & descriptions, Business Profile & reviews
method: Set up conversions first (form, call, WhatsApp) in Google Ads + GTM + GA4
Build keyword groups by sector × city; add negatives (jobs, recipes, home catering)
Launch the 2 Search campaigns; send clicks to the Request a quote page
Start remarketing once 1,000+ visitors are in the audience
Review weekly on the performance board: scale, fix or stop each campaign by CPL/CPQL
spend: Contract catering by sector & city · SAR 1,200 / month
Corporate & industrial catering KSA · SAR 500 / month
pillars.note: Targets based on 2026 benchmarks (business services CPC ≈ USD 5.9, conversion ≈ 4.9%). Replace with our account data after month 1.

pillars.name: ChatGPT campaign
pillars.aim: Be the catering brand people see when they ask ChatGPT.
items: Open the OpenAI Ads Manager account
Ad creatives, messages & ad groups by sector
Landing page + tracking (GA4, GTM, Clarity)
Launch month 1 with SAR 1,500 (≈ SAR 50 a day)
Weekly performance check and optimisation
method: Open OpenAI Ads Manager and install the pixel
Create ad groups for the 6 target sectors
Send clicks to a Request a quote landing page
Launch at about SAR 50 a day
Optimise weekly, report monthly

pillars.name: WhatsApp & leads
pillars.aim: Every enquiry lands in one WhatsApp inbox, gets a fast answer, and we know exactly where it came from.
items: WhatsApp Cloud API on our 2 sales numbers · one shared inbox (Chatwoot)
AI assistant qualifies the lead, then hands over to sales
Click-to-WhatsApp ads on Instagram & Facebook (small, fixed test)
Every chat labelled by source: Website · Google · ChatGPT · LinkedIn · Meta ads
Claude saves each client's details, summary & next step
Broadcasts to opted-in contacts (max 2 a month)
method: Verify Al Mays in Meta Business Manager; connect both sales numbers to the WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta, no platform fee) and add them as 2 inboxes in Chatwoot
Set up the Captain AI assistant: answers FAQs, asks sector, meals & city, then hands over to sales 1 or 2
One WhatsApp link per channel (pre-filled message + UTM) so the source is labelled automatically
Run small Click-to-WhatsApp ads in Meta Ads Manager; scale only if CPL is good
Connect Claude (MCP connector): client record, chat summary, weekly leads & CPL by source
Monthly broadcast from approved templates to opted-in contacts; track replies & quotes
tools: Shared inbox, 2 WhatsApp numbers, AI assistant, labels & reports
Official API, no platform fee · pay per message
Saves client info, chat summaries, source reports
Which page or campaign started the chat
spend: USD 19 per agent / month × 3 agents (2 sales + marketing) · ≈ SAR 215 / month
≈ SAR 0.22 per marketing message · ≈ 600 broadcasts a month · replies within 24h & ad chats (72h) free
Meta Ads Manager · SAR 150 a month (≈ SAR 5 a day)

gpt.objective: Make Al Mays visible inside ChatGPT to people looking for catering, institutional food services and large-scale meal solutions, and turn that into qualified leads and website traffic.
outcomes: Know which sectors and messages work best
Data to decide on future investment
gpt.ask: Approve SAR 6,000 for a 3-month pilot (Nov–Jan), reviewed monthly.
gpt.note: ChatGPT ads are open to Saudi businesses through OpenAI Ads Manager; campaigns start from about SAR 50 a day.

budget.note: Proposed allocation for the plan period (Nov–Jan): ChatGPT pilot, website tools, Google SEO tool and WhatsApp lead capture. Social media runs in-house.
lines: Chatwoot, Meta messages & Click-to-WhatsApp ads · fixed SAR 500/month

F: Content review & editing, photography, strategy, website plan
A: Social media management & publishing, website execution

mp.main: Make Al Mays the catering brand companies find, trust and contact — on social media, on Google and inside ChatGPT — and capture every enquiry on WhatsApp.
mp.cont: Part of a 3-month plan · to be continued until we reach the main goal, then kept running and improved.
objectives: Publish consistently in the new design
Feed posts · stories · LinkedIn activity posts
Turn the website into a sales tool
Be found on Google — paid & organic
Leads & CPL per campaign · organic visits
Test ChatGPT as a lead source
CPL · CPQL · CAC per campaign, every week
Scale / fix / stop decision per campaign
Chats tagged by source · first reply time · CPL by source

cadence: ChatGPT campaign: impressions, CTR, CPC, leads
WhatsApp: chats, qualified leads & CPL by source (Claude report)
Monthly report: KPIs vs targets, budget, lessons

risks: ChatGPT ads are new for B2B catering
Small 3-month pilot, weekly review; shift budget to Google Ads or LinkedIn if cost per lead is too high
Use page-builder tools in-house; keep a page-by-page checklist
Approve the monthly calendar in one go on the board
Not enough photos for daily content
Monthly shoot day + reuse corporate video clips
situation: Posting is irregular and reports show screenshots, not KPIs. A new post design is ready for approval.
Outdated photos, broken counters (0+), phone & email links not clickable, missing branches, no WhatsApp button.
Business Profile incomplete; Google Ads running without clear conversion tracking or cost per client.
ChatGPT ads just opened to Saudi businesses — an early-mover chance in B2B catering.

perfTask.name: Google Ads campaign performance measurement
perfTask.why: One weekly view of cost per lead, cost per qualified lead and cost per client for every campaign — so we know where to put more money and which campaign to stop.

oneoff.name: Corporate video
oneoff.note: Paid once for the corporate video shoot. Kept separate from the monthly marketing budget.
items: Video production crew
Filming team costs
Shoot cash float
On-hand cash for essentials & surprises during the shoot
